questions.question: A defective dining set costing Rs. 10000 is being sold at 10% loss. If the price is further reduced successively by 5%, then the selling price is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive reduction formula can be directly applied to the initial cost to find the final selling price.

Selling Price (SP) = CP × [(100 − L₁) ÷ 100] × [(100 − L₂) ÷ 100]

SP = 10000 × (90 ÷ 100) × (95 ÷ 100)

SP = 10000 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 8550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594cd4ff8bead22426fbc77fc99fdd0a1cd8a9fd7816981c71d07240313c769c.png] 

**Given:**

Initial Cost Price of dining set = ₹10000

Loss percentage = 10%

Successive reduction percentage = 5%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 10% loss = 10000 − (10% of 10000)

⇒ Price after 10% loss = 10000 − 1000 = ₹9000

⇒ Final Selling Price after further 5% reduction = 9000 − (5% of 9000)

⇒ Final Selling Price = 9000 − 450 = ₹8550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Successive Reduction

When two successive reductions of a% and b% are applied, the net equivalent reduction percentage is given by the formula: (a + b − a × b ÷ 100)%.

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit and Loss are always computed on the Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated otherwise. SP = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss)% ÷ 100.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

A discount is always offered on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100.

questions.question: 9 boys and 12 men can complete a work in 24 days. Each boy takes thrice the time taken by a man to complete the work. In how many days will 15 men complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Given:

9B + 12M = 24 days

B = 3M

Formula used:

Time = 1/Efficiency

Solution:

Let, m = total work done

Work done by 9 boys = 9/3m

Work done by 12 men = 12/m 

⇒ 9/3m + 12/m = 1/24

(3 + 12) x 24 = m

m = 15 x 24 days = 360

The number of days required by 15 men to complete the work = (360)/15 = 24 days.

The answer is 24 days.

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 150 percent of the cost price. If 30 percent discount is given, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Given

Marked price is 150% of the cost price

Discount = 30%

Concept:

Profit percentage is calculated as (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100%

Solution:

Selling price after discount = 150% - 30% of 150%

= 150% - 45% = 105%

Profit percentage = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100%

= (105% - 100%)/100% × 100% = 5%

Therefore, the profit percentage is 5%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**MP/CP = (100 + profit%)/(100 - discount%)

150/100 = (100 + p)/70 

⇒ 3/2 = (100 + p)/70 

⇒ 105 = 100 + p 

⇒ p = 5%

questions.question: Average of 4 numbers is 45. Average of first two numbers is thrice the average of other two numbers. What is the sum of first two numbers?
questions.solution:
Given: 

The average of four numbers is 45

The average of the first two numbers is thrice the average of the other two numbers

Concept used:

Average × Number of entities = Total

Calculation:

Let the first two numbers be a and b and the last two be c and d.

⇒ (a + b)/2 = 3 × (c + d)/2

⇒ (a + b) = 3 × (c + d)

⇒ a + b + c + d = 4 × 45 = 180

⇒ a + b + (a + b)/3 = 180

⇒ a + b (1 + 1/3) = 180

⇒ a + b × 4/3 = 180 

⇒ a + b = 135

∴ The answer is 135.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

Let the average of the last two numbers be 1 unit.

Then the average of the first two numbers = 1 × 3 = 3 units

The sum of the first two = 2 × 3 = 6 units

⇒ 1 × 2 + 2 × 3 = 4 × 45

⇒ 8 units = 180

⇒ 6 units = 180 × 6/8 = 135

questions.question: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to Rs. 212 in 2 years and to Rs. 224 in 4 years. The sum is:
questions.solution:
Given 

Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212 

Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224 

Formula Used 

Amount = Principal + n(Simple Interest) (where n = no. of years) 

Calculation 

Let the Principal be P

Amount in 2 years = Rs. 212

⇒ P + 2(S.I) = Rs. 212 ---(1) 

Amount in 4 years = Rs. 224

⇒ P + 4(S.I) = Rs. 224 ---(2) 

Subtract (1) and (2)

⇒ S.I = Rs. 6 

Put the value of S.I in eq (1) 

⇒ P + 2(6) = Rs. 212

⇒ P = Rs. 200

∴ The required answer is Rs. 200

questions.question: What is that least perfect square which is exactly divisible by each of 14, 84 and 28?
questions.solution:
Given:

The numbers are 14, 84 and 28.

Formula:

The least number which is exactly divisible by each one of the given numbers is called their LCM.

Calculation:

LCM of 14, 84 and 28 

14 = 2 × 7

84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7

28 = 2 × 2 × 7

LCM of 14, 84 and 28 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7 = 84

To make the number perfect square multiply by 3 and 7 in 84, then

⇒ 84 × 3 × 7 

⇒ 1764

**∴ The least number which is a perfect square and is divisible by each of the numbers 14, 84 and 28 is 1764.**

questions.question: Ramesh sells an article at a loss of 20 percent. If he buys it for 30 percent less price and sells it for Rs. 36 less price, then his profit will be 10 percent. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
Given:

Loss% on article = 20%

The selling price is reduced by Rs. 36

New profit = 10%

Formula Used:

Profit% = (Selling Price - Cost Price) × 100/Cost Price

Calculation:

Let the initial Cost Price be 100A

SP = 100A × (1 - 20/100) = 80A

According to Question

New Cost Price = 100A × (1 - 30/100) = 70A

New SP = 70A × (1 + 10/100) = 77A

Now as the selling price is reduced by Rs. 36

77A = 80A - 36 ⇒ 3A = 36 ⇒ A = 12

∴ Initial Cost Price = 100A → 100 × 12 = 1200

**The answer is 1200**

questions.question: A 1000 metres long train is running at the speed of 72 km/hr. If it crosses a bridge in 85 seconds, then what is the length of the bridge?
questions.solution:
Given:

Length of train = 1000 m

Speed of train = 72 km/hr

The train crossed the bridge in 85 seconds.

Concept used:

To cross the bridge, the train needs to travel = Length of train + length of the bridge

Speed × Time = Distance

Calculation:

Length of train = 1000 m

Let the length of the bridge be x

Time taken to cross the bridge = 85 sec.

Speed = 72 kmph = (72 × 5)/18 = 20 m/sec.

To cross the bridge, the train needs to travel = Length of train + length of bridge = 1000 + x

Now,

Speed × Time = Distance

20 × 85 = 1000 + x

⇒ x = 1700 – 1000 = 700

∴ Length of the bridge = 700 m.

**The answer is 700 m.**

questions.question: The average height of 40 sticks is 156 cm. Some sticks of average height 162 cm are taken out. If the new average height is 150 cm, then how many sticks are remaining?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average height of 40 sticks is 154 cm

Formula used

Average = Sum of all values/Total no. of values

Calculation:

Average of 40 sticks = (Sum of Length of 40 sticks) /40

⇒ 156 = (sum of length 40 sticks) /40

⇒ Sum of length 40 sticks = 6240

Let x sticks be taken out

Average of x sticks = (sum of length of x stick) /x

⇒ 162 = (sum of length of x sticks) /x

⇒ Sum of length of x sticks = 162x

Now, Remaining sticks = 40 - x

Average of (40 - x) sticks = {sum of length of (40 - x) stick} /(40 - x)

⇒ 150 = {sum of length of (40 - x) sticks} /(40 - x)

⇒ Sum of length of (40 - x) sticks = 150(40 - x) = 6000 - 150x

According to the question,

⇒ 162x + 6000 - 150x = 6240

⇒ 12x = 240

⇒ x = 20

Remaining sticks = 40 - x = 40 - 20 = 20

∴ The correct answer is 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

Calculation:

Combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂)/(n₁ + n₂)

⇒ 156 = [162n + 150(40 - n)]/40

⇒ 6240 = 162n - 150n + 6000

⇒ 12n = 240

⇒ n = 20

Remaining sticks = 40 - n = 40 - 20 = 20

∴ The correct answer is 20.
